metadata.description: Real-world news events for Imbryk initial seed, March 2026

events.prompt: US and Israel launch coordinated strikes on Iran, Supreme Leader Khamenei killed in targeted attack on Tehran
Iran retaliates against US military bases in Bahrain, Qatar and Iraq following Khamenei assassination
Hezbollah launches mass rocket barrages on northern Israel as Iran-Israel conflict escalates
Oil prices surge past multi-year highs as Strait of Hormuz shipping faces disruption threat
UN Security Council holds emergency session on Middle East escalation after Iran strikes
Iran's Interim Leadership Council takes power following Supreme Leader Khamenei's death, succession crisis begins
Russia-Ukraine war enters fourth year with front line stalemate across Donbas, no peace talks in sight
Trump administration imposes 10% baseline global import tariff, reshaping world trade
US withdraws from World Health Organisation, WHO funding reduced by 18 percent
DeepSeek R1 released, Chinese AI model achieves frontier reasoning at fraction of US training cost
Solar and wind energy met 109 percent of new global electricity demand in 2025, record 600 GW solar added
2025 confirmed as hottest year on record, global temperature anomaly reaches 1.47 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels
Bulgaria adopts euro on January 1 2026, becomes 21st member of eurozone
South Korea's President Yoon Suk-yeol convicted of insurrection and sentenced to life imprisonment
Japan snap election: LDP wins majority, Sanae Takaichi becomes Japan's first female Prime Minister
Davos 2026 attracts record 60 heads of state as world leaders scramble for global coordination
Trump signs executive order limiting state AI regulation to preserve federal authority over artificial intelligence
First bespoke CRISPR gene-editing treatment administered to baby KJ Muldoon, personalised medicine milestone
Gaza humanitarian crisis deepens as ceasefire negotiations collapse again, October elections loom in Israel
China increases military incursions into Taiwan's air defence zone to near-daily frequency
US-China trade truce: fragile 90-day agreement holds 30 percent US tariffs and 10 percent Chinese tariffs
Sudan civil war: SAF-RSF conflict creates one of world's worst humanitarian disasters, millions displaced
GLP-1 drugs Ozempic and Wegovy adoption accelerates, reshaping healthcare economics and pharmaceutical markets
Germany's CDU forms new coalition under Friedrich Merz following snap election, eurozone's largest economy grows at 0.9 percent
US spot Bitcoin ETFs accumulate significant institutional assets, Trump administration signals crypto-friendly policy
IBM announces quantum computing milestone, narrowing gap to commercial quantum advantage
EU AI Act enters enforcement phase, setting global standard for artificial intelligence regulation
BRICS+ nations explore dollar-alternative payment systems, Brazil and India push for Global South financial independence
US semiconductor export controls on China intensify supply chain bifurcation, TSMC Arizona fabs ramp up production
NATO announces increased eastern flank deployments as Russia-Ukraine war continues into fourth year
Anti-AI labour movement grows globally, creative and professional workers demand AI use transparency and royalty funds
Macron navigates hung parliament as France's political fragmentation deepens following 2024 snap election
EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism becomes operational, taxing high-carbon imports at European borders
Elon Musk's X platform amplifies state-sponsored disinformation while becoming primary news source for millions
India emerges as global manufacturing hub as multinationals diversify supply chains away from China
Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping continue, global maritime insurance costs at record highs
Over 150 active gene-editing clinical trials underway globally as CRISPR therapies enter mainstream medicine
US carrier strike groups deployed to Gulf region as Iran conflict escalates, Middle East most dangerous since 1973
Keir Starmer's Labour government pursues closer EU-UK relations without rejoining single market
Bank of Japan raises interest rates cautiously as it exits decades of ultra-loose monetary policy
